title.en: Two Thresholds on the Same Photo

brief.zh: 照片和目标类别保持相同，只改变置信度门槛，观察框是否留下。
brief.en: Keep the photo and class settings fixed. Change only the confidence threshold and see if the box stays.

concept.zh: 候选分数低于门槛时会被筛掉。
concept.en: A candidate drops out when its score is below the threshold.

hints.zh: 先运行一次查看分数，再把门槛调得比它高。
hints.en: Run once to read the score, then raise the threshold above it.

prompt.zh: 以 50% 运行，记下框的置信度。再用 95% 运行一次，比较两次的框。
prompt.en: Run at 50% and note the box's confidence. Run again at 95% and compare the results.
